title: Answer a technical interview with evidence
summary: Giải thích một technical decision, contribution, trade-off và measured result.

sections.title: Your mission
sections.body: An interviewer asks about a production decision you personally influenced.

sections.title: Candidate notes
sections.content: API p95 1.8s; target below 700ms; you found N+1 queries, proposed batching, added load tests; p95 became 520ms and DB load fell 28%.

exercises.question: Which phrase proves personal contribution?
options: I profiled the queries, proposed batching and added load tests.
correctAnswer: I profiled the queries, proposed batching and added load tests.
exercises.explanation: It names decisions and actions owned by the candidate.

performanceTask.title: Tell the decision story
performanceTask.scenario: Answer: Tell me about a technical decision you made under a deadline.
performanceTask.baselinePrompt: Answer cold from the notes without model/chunks.
performanceTask.performancePrompt: Speak for up to two minutes: context, options/constraint, your decision, result and reflection.
performanceTask.modelResponse: Before a major campaign, API p95 latency reached 1.8 seconds. I profiled the request and found an N+1 query path. I chose batching over a cache because it removed the root cause and was safer before launch. I added load tests and coordinated a gradual rollout with SRE. P95 fell to 520 milliseconds and database load fell by 28 percent. Looking back, I would add query-count alerts earlier.
performanceTask.retryPrompt: Dùng database migration case mới; làm rõ option, constraint và why.
performanceTask.transferPrompt: Không xem model/chunks: explain a decision that reduced deployment failures.
performanceTask.reviewPrompt: Answer a new technical-decision question about build performance.

artifacts.title: Decision facts
artifacts.content: p95 1.8s; target 700ms; options cache/batching; chose batching; result 520ms and DB load -28%.

artifacts.title: Migration facts
artifacts.content: 900GB table; 20-minute maintenance window; options big-bang/dual-write; chose dual-write; cutover downtime 90 seconds.

artifacts.title: Release facts
artifacts.content: Failure rate 14%; options manual checklist/canary gate; chose automated canary; failures fell to 3%; rollout +8 minutes.

artifacts.title: Build facts
artifacts.content: CI 24 min; options larger runners/test sharding; chose sharding; CI 11 min; flaky isolation cost increased.

rubric.label: Complete decision story
rubric.description: Connects context, options or constraint, decision, result and reflection.

rubric.label: Decision rationale
rubric.description: Explains why the chosen option fit the constraint.

rubric.label: Measured evidence
rubric.description: Uses a concrete result and names a cost or lesson.

audio.text: P ninety-five fell to five hundred and twenty milliseconds.
The trade-off was eight extra rollout minutes.
The deadline ruled out a full rewrite.
Given the deadline, I compared caching with batching.

training.question: What is compared?
training.feedback: Given the deadline makes the constraint explicit.

audio.text: I chose batching because it removed the root cause.
The result was lower latency and lower database load.

training.question: How many outcomes?
training.feedback: Keep final sounds in results and costs.

audio.text: The benefit was safety, but rollout took longer.

training.question: What structure is used?
training.feedback: Pause before but to expose the cost.

audio.text: I added load tests and coordinated the canary.

training.question: What is this evidence?
training.feedback: Use I plus specific action verbs.

audio.text: Looking back, I would add alerts earlier.
I selected an automated canary instead of a manual checklist.
Deployment failures fell from fourteen to three percent.
The canary added eight minutes to rollout.
Release pressure limited our migration window.

pronunciationCues.articulatoryCue: Nhấn CHOSE/SELECTED và hai option; giảm nhẹ từ nối.
pronunciationCues.meaningRisk: Nếu option không nổi bật, interviewer không biết quyết định cụ thể là gì.

pronunciationCues.articulatoryCue: Tách before | after và đọc rõ đơn vị milliseconds/percent.
pronunciationCues.meaningRisk: Mất đơn vị hoặc contrast làm measured evidence sai nghĩa.

interactionTurns.expectedFunction: compare the rejected option against the constraint

interactionTurns.prompt: Give me the decision and result in one sentence.
interactionTurns.expectedFunction: recap choice and measured outcome concisely
